resources.string: An exact prediction, including zero, earns 10 + the prediction. A missed prediction earns 0.\n\nExact zero → 10 points. An exact prediction of three earns 13 points.

Exact zero earns 7 points. Another exact prediction earns 10 + the prediction. A missed prediction earns 0.\n\nIf an exact prediction is strictly greater than half the cards dealt, add a majority bonus of min(cards dealt, 10). Exactly half earns no bonus. Only the bonus is capped at 10; the total round score is not capped.
Exact zero earns %1$d points. Another exact prediction earns %2$d + (%3$d × the prediction). A missed prediction earns 0.

The majority bonus applies only to an exact prediction strictly greater than half the cards dealt. It adds min(cards dealt, 10) points. Exactly half earns no bonus. The 10-point cap applies only to this bonus, never the total score.

Set the reward for an exact zero, the base reward for another exact prediction, and the points added per correctly predicted trick. Missed predictions always earn 0. The optional majority bonus uses the same strict threshold and 10-point bonus cap as Aggressive.
